_comment: port     : the engine's HTTP + WebSocket port (loopback only)
qq_exe   : full path to QQ.exe -- install.ps1 fills this in for you
qq_cwd   : working directory to launch QQ from (usually qq_exe's folder)
self_uin : your QQ number; 0 means auto-detect from data_dir
data_dir : account data directory, e.g. <QQ dir>\Tencent Files\<uin>
the engine needs it to find image caches and to serve /media
ws_token : leave empty to disable WS auth, or put a secret here
install.ps1 generates one per machine into js/ws_token.txt
